subject: Lighthouse evaluation: mini-sprint & security checkpoints (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)
messages:
From: Ethan Clark <ethan.clark@heliobank.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@heliobank.com; olivia.reed@heliobank.com
Date: Mon, 1 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lighthouse evaluation and MAP alignment - SOC2 / SIG / DPA

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. HelioBank is ready to move into an accelerated evaluation window but procurement and engineering need a short, tightly scoped MAP that captures the compliance gates we require before we can sign. High level asks:

- SOC 2 evidence and timeline for an evidence run (read-only logs + attestation excerpts).
- SIG/CAIQ answers for data flow and isolation (we'll want the spreadsheet).
- DPA draft and proposed data retention carveouts for transaction logs (we retain for 7 years; we need to confirm options).

Can your team produce a 2-week mini-sprint MAP that lays out milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria? Procurement prefers a target close window of Apr 15-20, but that's flexible if the compliance run needs extra time.

Please loop in whoever owns SOC 2 artifacts on your side. Attaching the HelioBank checklist we've been using.

Thanks,
Ethan Clark
Director, Cloud Security
HelioBank
[Attachment: HelioBank_Compliance_Checklist.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Clark <ethan.clark@heliobank.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai; ben.carter@redwood.ai; laura.bennett@redwood.ai; procurement@heliobank.com
Date: Mon, 1 Apr 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Lighthouse evaluation and MAP alignment - SOC2 / SIG / DPA

Ethan — appreciate the clear asks. We've sketched a focused MAP 'mini-sprint' aimed at hitting an evidence run and DPA agreement within two weeks. Attached are: the MAP draft, our SOC 2 question matrix (pre-filled where possible), and an initial DPA proposal with a few standard carveouts for log retention.

Summary of the MAP mini-sprint (proposed):
- Sprint window: Apr 3 - Apr 14 (10 business days)
- Milestone A (Apr 5): SIG/CAIQ inventory submitted (owner: Ben)
- Milestone B (Apr 9): SOC 2 artifacts & sample logs uploaded to shared drive (owner: Neha)
- Milestone C (Apr 11-13): Evidence run & verification by HelioBank (owner: Marissa / HelioBank leads)
- Milestone D (Apr 14): DPA redline consensus and DocuSign send (owner: Laura)

Acceptance criteria (short):
- HelioBank confirms SIG answers map to your control families for data isolation and key management.
- SOC 2 artifacts include: system description excerpt, control narrative for access management, sample audit logs (redacted), and SOC 2 readiness checklist responses.
- DPA includes retention windows and export controls; if HelioBank requires >5 year retention for certain logs, we propose a commercial carveout with encrypted cold storage and retrieval SLA.

Immediate asks for your team: please confirm the acceptance criteria above and whether the Apr 3 start/Apr 14 finish works for procurement. If procurement needs additional legal approvals, flag the gating items so we can prioritize them.

Attachments: MAP-Lighthouse-v1.2.docx; SOC2_Questions_v2.xlsx; DPA-Proposal-HelioBank.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

On Mon, Apr 1, 2028 at 11:04 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Summary of the MAP mini-sprint (proposed):
> - Sprint window: Apr 3 - Apr 14 (10 business days)
> - Milestone A (Apr 5): SIG/CAIQ inventory submitted (owner: Ben)
> - Milestone B (Apr 9): SOC 2 artifacts & sample logs uploaded to shared drive (owner: Neha)

Thanks Marissa — quick technical notes and proposed clarifications for acceptance criteria so the evidence run isn't blocked mid-sprint:

- Logs: we will provide redacted audit logs with second-level timestamps for the last 90 days for service-level verification. If HelioBank needs longer retention for the evaluation, we can export a 12-month compressed snapshot but that will take an extra 24 hours to prepare.
- Data residency: hosted instances for this eval will be in us-west-2; export controls and encryption at rest are enabled by default.
- Key management: we support customer-managed keys (KMS) in the Dedicated/Private paths; for hosted evaluation we'll provide key rotation logs and KMS policy excerpts.

Proposed tweak to acceptance criteria: add an explicit "evidence sufficiency" check on Apr 11 where HelioBank confirms whether the sample artifacts meet your auditors' bar. If not, we schedule a 48-hour follow-up window to deliver additional items.

I'll upload the SOC2_Questions_v2.xlsx answers tonight and add a short inventory CSV to the Drive link Marissa shared.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Principal, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SIG-Inventory-answers.zip]

From: Olivia Reed <olivia.reed@heliobank.com>

Subject: Re: Lighthouse evaluation and MAP alignment - SOC2 / SIG / DPA

Marissa / Neha — thank you, this draft MAP looks actionable and concise. Procurement has reviewed the sprint window and we are aligned with a target close the week of Apr 15 provided the evidence run completes satisfactorily. A few clarifications and next steps: 

- Evidence run window: Apr 11-13 (we will have two engineers verify logs and control mappings). Please ensure redacted logs are uploaded by Apr 9 EOD.
- DPA: legal requests a single redline turn on Apr 12; if you can get a DocuSign-ready copy by Apr 14 we can route for signatures Apr 15.
- Retention: HelioBank requires a 7-year retention option for transaction audit logs. We accept your proposed encrypted cold storage carveout but need the retrieval SLA (48-72 hours) documented in the DPA.

Linking to procurement milestones: once the SOC2 acceptance checkpoint passes, procurement will unlock the final approval. HubSpot deal HB-2028-042 has procurement tasks tied to Apr 15.

We'll proceed with the evidence sufficiency check on Apr 11 and will notify you immediately if we need additional artifacts. Please send the DocuSign link after Laura uploads the redline-ready DPA.

Thanks,
Olivia Reed
VP, IT Risk & Compliance
HelioBank
